headline: Maui County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

meeting.body: Maui County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee
meeting.voteItem: Close public testimony on the youth mental health crisis support item
meeting.summary: YouthLine Hawaiʻi described its youth crisis line, presenters proposed a youth campus on golf course land, and both items were deferred.
meeting.recap: The committee had two items: youth mental health crisis support, and a proposed community resilience and youth development campus.[[0:03:00]] YouthLine Hawaiʻi said it is a peer-to-peer help and crisis line for young people ages 10 to 24.[[0:09:32]] YouthLine said it started running its call center on Maui in January.[[0:21:34]] YouthLine said the service is free, confidential, and needs no parental consent.[[0:41:11]] YouthLine said it is funded through grants, including one federal and one state grant.[[0:47:18]] YouthLine said it does not get any County funding right now.[[1:02:30]] The presenters said they were not asking for approvals or funding.[[1:15:00]] A presenter said the group would seek a special use permit instead of a full rezoning.[[1:19:08]] A council member said a special use permit usually must be renewed and may make funding harder to get.[[1:23:07]] Another council member urged the presenters to work with professional planners.[[1:35:01]] A presenter estimated the project would take three to five years once permits and funding are in place.[[1:54:00]] The committee deferred the campus item with no objections.[[1:58:44]]
decided: The committee closed public testimony on the youth mental health item with no objections stated.
The committee deferred the youth mental health crisis support item with no objections stated.
The committee deferred the proposed youth development campus item with no objections.
meeting.next: YouthLine said Molokaʻi and Lānaʻi schools will be its outreach focus this coming school year. A presenter said they would seek guidance from professionals and make a specific plan.

moments.q: "Today, we're not requesting approvals. We're not requesting any fundings."
"We'll go as fast as the council lets us."
